referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory for 1 MJ heat from natural gas, burned in a cogeneration unit with a capacity of 15 kWth. The multioutput process "natural gas, burned in cogen 15kWth delivers the coproducts "heat, at cogen 15kWth, natural gas, allocation exergy" and "electricity, at cogen 15kWth, natural gas, allocation exergy". The energy efficiency is 30% for electricity and 60% for heat. The economic factor is 0.74 for electricity and 0.26 for heat. This leads to the allocation factor of 0.58 for electricity and 0.42 for heat.; UUID: f3a11ef7-f31e-33ad-9288-df964c6cc4bc
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the diesel burning in a 15 kWth cogen unit which in turn includes fuel input, infrastructure (boiler), air and water emissions and electrictiy needed for operation. The efficiency and economic allocation is considered
